headline: Shipbuilding margin widens but net profit falls
summary_short: Hanwha Ocean reported Q3 revenue of ₩3.41T, up 12.9% y/y, and operating profit of ₩485.7B, up 67.6%, while EPS fell to ₩455 from ₩860.
summary_long: Net profit fell 46.1% y/y to ₩145.1B. Versus Q2, revenue fell 37.3% and operating profit fell 34.0%. Press reports attribute the sequential drop to temporary revenue recognition on marine projects delivered in Q2, and expect one-time costs to affect Q4 profitability.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue, operating profit and margin are from Korean press coverage of the Oct. 27, 2026 results; EPS comparisons are from the shard. The shard reported date is Nov. 11; the summary uses the Oct. 27 results date.
